alt_text: Paired-difference panels compare Mall with Walk, Walk with PT, and Mall with PT across accepted dates for available heart-rate, HRV, and mechanical metrics.
interpretation: Paired differences are interpreted per metric and comparison; mixed direction is retained rather than converted into a universal result.
limitation: Inference is bounded to accepted same-day triplets; fixed order, duration, and environment can contribute to observed differences, and results remain N-of-1.
limitations: Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
long_description: Paired differences are interpreted per metric and comparison; mixed direction is retained rather than converted into a universal result. Positive and negative differences retain each metric's stated direction rule. Unavailable Stress/SNS/PNS comparisons have no plotted values. Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
qualifications: Positive and negative differences retain each metric's stated direction rule.
Unavailable Stress/SNS/PNS comparisons have no plotted values.
question: Which paired measures changed across accepted same-day Mall → Walk → PT triplets?
source_labels: Accepted Mall → Walk → PT Skate protocol
title: Accepted-triplet paired comparisons
